usage: qnx6read [-h] [--image IMAGE] [--char-device] [{P2,P3}] [extract SRC DST ...]

qnx6read: minimal read-only QNX6 (Power-Safe) reader for the JACE-8000 SD image (B674).

Lists the directory tree of one partition of a raw disk image, or extracts one file. READ-ONLY.

Usage:
  qnx6read [--image disk.img] [P2|P3]                  list the tree (default P2)
  qnx6read [--image disk.img] P2 extract <src> <dst>  copy one file out of the image
The image comes from --image, else from the QNX6_IMG environment variable: a regular file or a block
device (`--image /dev/sdb` reads the card directly); a character device (a BSD raw disk /dev/rdiskN)
only with --char-device, so a terminal or /dev/null is never read as a disk.
Exit 0 ok, 1 listing incomplete (depth limit hit), 2 usage (no image, an image that is not a file or a
block device, an unreadable image, bad arguments).

positional arguments:
  {P2,P3}          partition (default P2)
  extract SRC DST  extract one file instead of listing

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --image IMAGE    raw disk image (default: $QNX6_IMG)
  --char-device    accept a character device as the image (a BSD raw disk); refused by default
